Remember this distinction: front-line social workers help people directly, while university teachers educate the people who help. One works in practice and the other in classrooms and laboratories.

A common path is: bachelor's and master's degrees in social work/sociology -> doctorate -> Postdoctoral Researcher or Lecturer -> build grants and publications -> Associate Professor/Professor.

This career suits people who love teaching, can conduct research, and want to support student growth. If explaining methods clearly and establishing sound evidence are your baseline, you can thrive in this field.

Social Work Teachers, Postsecondary teach practice and theory in university social work programs, supervise student internships, theses, and career development, and conduct research on social welfare, policy evaluation, and interventions. They develop both social-work talent and knowledge.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 17,100 postsecondary social work teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 17,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with approximately 1,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $76,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).

AI will not replace postsecondary social work teachers, but it will redesign teaching and research workflows. When AI handles lesson materials, literature discovery, and preliminary grading, teachers shift from repetitive work to classroom guidance, internship supervision, and professional judgment. People who educate effectively, conduct evidence-based research, and establish professional standards are truly scarce.

paragraphs: A score of 7/10 indicates medium-high AI exposure in instructional support. Automation absorbs much material preparation and grading, but people retain an essential role in teaching guidance and supervision.

Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Repetitive instructional support gets replaced, not teaching positions. Faculty who educate effectively, conduct evidence-based research, and supervise internships become even scarcer. Those who only read from PPT slides and avoid fieldwork face the greatest risk.
Build a foundation in social work or sociology and develop both research and practice while in school. The AI era rewards teaching ability and evidence-based research, not memorized theory alone.
Advance from lecturing to dual teaching and research tracks. Build funded projects and practice partnerships and pursue academic promotion rather than teaching mechanically from texts.
Highlight doctoral training and practice experience, and specify what you have published and supervised. Funded projects and fieldwork are preferred.
Do not hire based only on publication counts; assess teaching and mentorship. Faculty who supervise internships and conduct industry research deserve resources.
